A '''braised warped fungus''' is the simple preparation of the [[warped fungus]], a secret [[ingredient]]. It heals {{Hp|2}} and gives {{EffectLink|Invisibility}} for 30 seconds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/brasied_warped_fungus.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
The recipe is secret and is never added to the recipe book.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes 0.8 seconds, heals {{Hp|2}} and gives Invisibility for 0:30.

It has no crafting use. Cooking one grants ''Hidden Flavors''.
